Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/unit ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/unit job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)

[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/unit/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
